title: Dual Walsh basis
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The characters $x\mapsto(-1)^{\psi(x)}$, indexed by all linear functionals $\psi:V\to\mathbb{F}_2$, form a basis of the real vector space of functions $V\to\bbr$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-vector space
